mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market and strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS are both above 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 3.0%) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation above 3.0%) typically triggers central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a strong consumer demand regime (when both retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) are above their 12-month moving averages), the S&P 500 tends to outperform due to robust economic growth and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both above 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST are both above 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
